history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A portrait of a young man with dark hair, posed in the water. He has delicate, iridescent, fairy-like wings attached to his ears, adorned with dangling blue and clear crystals. He is wearing intricate, shimmering jewelry made of pearls and crystals that drape across his shoulders and chest, featuring a prominent pendant with a large purple gem. The water around him is dark blue and reflects the moonlight, creating a sparkling effect. The background consists of dark, rocky outcroppings and the deep blue of the ocean at night. The lighting is dramatic and ethereal, with a cool, luminous glow highlighting the subject's skin and the jewel-like embellishments. The overall mood is mystical, enchanting, and slightly melancholic. The style is highly stylized, bordering on fantasy art or a high-fashion editorial. The color palette is dominated by deep blues, purples, and iridescent silvers, with subtle hints of pink on the lips.
